title: VK-only Read/Write Multiple Registers mixed-count valid state probe
purpose: Exercise the combined read/write register path with a plausible state-sensitive request that writes two registers while reading back one nearby register, targeting issue themes around repeated or mixed operations without requiring an external setup script.
expected_behavior: The target should parse the mixed read/write layout, consume exactly the declared write byte count, and either perform the operation or return an exception without corrupting state.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 000f matches unit identifier plus 14-byte PDU
Target operation remains Read/Write Multiple Registers
Write quantity 0002 is consistent with byte count 04 and four data bytes
issue_safety_notes: Although inspired by state-sensitive issue reports, this sequence is a single internally consistent combined-operation request and avoids reproducing historical multi-frame crash material.
